replenishment_proposals_live_uq.name: replenishment_proposals_live_uq
replenishment_proposals_live_uq.where: status in ('pending', 'approved') and shelf_id is null

replenishment_proposals_shelf_live_uq.name: replenishment_proposals_shelf_live_uq
replenishment_proposals_shelf_live_uq.where: status in ('pending', 'approved') and shelf_id is not null

replenishment_settings_scope_key.name: replenishment_settings_scope_key
replenishment_settings_scope_key.value:
(scope = 'default' and vantage_customer_id is null and drms_equipment_id is null)
       or (scope = 'customer' and vantage_customer_id is not null and drms_equipment_id is null)
       or (scope = 'device' and drms_equipment_id is not null and vantage_customer_id is null)

replenishment_settings_threshold_range.name: replenishment_settings_threshold_range
replenishment_settings_threshold_range.value:
coalesce(threshold_black, 0) between 0 and 100 and coalesce(threshold_cyan, 0) between 0 and 100
       and coalesce(threshold_magenta, 0) between 0 and 100 and coalesce(threshold_yellow, 0) between 0 and 100

site_stock_shelves_holding.name: site_stock_shelves_holding
site_stock_shelves_holding.value: holding_black between 0 and 20 and holding_cyan between 0 and 20 and holding_magenta between 0 and 20 and holding_yellow between 0 and 20 and holding_waste between 0 and 20

site_stock_shelves_used.name: site_stock_shelves_used
site_stock_shelves_used.value: used_black >= 0 and used_cyan >= 0 and used_magenta >= 0 and used_yellow >= 0 and used_waste >= 0
